local p = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer local hud = p.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("AsuraHUD") return "clientReady=" .. tostring(p:GetAttribute("AsuraClientReady")) .. " hud=" .. tostring(hud ~= nil) .. " char=" .. tostring(p.Character) .. " scripts=" .. #p.PlayerScripts:GetDescendants()
local out = {} for _, p in game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers() do table.insert(out, p.Name .. " char=" .. tostring(p.Character)) end return table.concat(out, ", ")
